nodes.question_edit: What is in this patient's file, and how far did the diagnosis actually get?
nodes.hint_edit: Every case in this subgroup records five facts: (a) was surgery performed, (b) was tissue sent to pathology, (c) was immunohistochemistry requested, (d) was the result unavailable or never requested, and (e) the ENCR basis of diagnosis. The description of the file that applies sets them. A tumour that was never diagnosed is still a tumour with recoverable facts on it - record what the file has, not "unknown".
